bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
base_run=44583321273
link_run=44753258961
original=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-4a1c5be3
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-pr62-20261120
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
old_id="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$original")" = "$old_id" || exit 63
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link62-release.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/base" "$tmp/link" "$tmp/overlay"
gh run download "$base_run" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/base" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
gh run download "$link_run" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/link" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/gaybbs.mjs "$tmp/live.mjs"
cmp -s "$tmp/base/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/live.mjs" || exit 66
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp/link:/source:ro" --entrypoint node "$original" --check /source/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 67
cp "$tmp/link/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/overlay/gaybbs.mjs"
cat >"$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$candidate" -f "$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" "$tmp/overlay" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 68
new_id="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
test "$old_id" != "$new_id" || exit 69
if docker image inspect "$rollback" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback")" = "$old_id" || exit 70
else docker tag "$old_id" "$rollback"; fi
restore(){
  docker tag "$rollback" "$original"
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
docker tag "$candidate" "$original"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 7
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$new_id"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --input-type=module -e '
import fs from "node:fs";
const p=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE;
const token=p?fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;
if(!token)process.exit(51);
try{const response=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/getMe",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(10000)});const json=await response.json();if(!json.ok||json.result.username!=="GayBBS_bot")process.exit(52);}catch{process.exit(53)}
'
trap - ERR
echo LINK_PR62_RUNTIME_IMAGE=PASS
echo LINK_PR62_BOT_AUTH=PASS
echo LINK_PR62_ROLLBACK_PRESERVED=PASS
echo OTHER_COMPOSE_SERVICES_NOT_RECREATED=PASS
